speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help determine the cause of your sudden vertigo, can you describe if the spinning sensation is constant or if it comes in brief episodes triggered by head movement? Also, have you experienced any hearing loss, ringing in your ears, or difficulty with balance during this episode?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. To further narrow down the cause, could you tell me if you have any history of high blood pressure, diabetes, or smoking, and did you experience any neurological symptoms like slurred speech, double vision, or limb weakness during the episode?

speaker: Patient
